title: Treatise on the Heavy Crescent Cut
summary: Turns the weight of the curved blade into splitting cuts for fighters whose primary meridians are fully open.

title: Method of the Glaive Line-Breaker
summary: Teaches a footman to sever spear shafts and open a hedge of pike points with the glaive.

title: Qi-Extended Crescent Manual
summary: Shows a Xiantian cultivator how to stretch the qi field along the curve so cuts and thrusts land beyond the steel.

title: Canon of the Glaive Duel Circle
summary: A canon for single combat with the glaive, shrinking the opponent's ground stroke by stroke until the exchange ends.

title: Azure Twin-Court Glaive Forms
summary: Treats blade and butt as a pair of weapons striking in tandem, each covering the other's opening.

title: River Bend Glaive Treatise
summary: Teaches flowing cuts and parries that follow the opponent's movement as a river follows its bends.

title: Hawk's Stoop and Rise Glaive Method
summary: A method of high waiting stances and sudden diving cuts, modelled on the hawk of the azure sky.

title: Basin Crossing Glaive Canon
summary: A full canon of low basin stances and river-stone steps that drives an opponent toward the centre of the ring.

title: Glaive Held to a Wind-Sworn Bearing
summary: Teaches the glaive fighter to take a bearing on the foe against the wind and hold it unbroken.

title: On the Plateau Rim and the Long Blade
summary: Teaches fighting with the glaive at the edge of the plateau, where open ground and a long drop favour the sworn fighter.

title: Gale-Cut Glaive Discipline
summary: A discipline of cuts that start slowly and end at gale speed, bound by the oath never to give ground.

title: Oath-Kept Glaive in Open Country
summary: Teaches the glaive on open grassland with no cover, where an oath sworn aloud fixes the order of each stroke.
